---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement, a format feature, or a new supported workflow
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## What problem would this solve?

Describe the use case and who it would help.

## What would you like to happen?

Describe the smallest useful version of the change. For a format feature, name
the format, the specification version, and the elements involved.

## Alternatives or related work

Describe any workaround, alternative, format specification, or related issue.

## Sample data

If a redistributable file would show the feature, link it and state its
license and origin. Do not attach files you are not allowed to share.

## Additional context

Add examples, links, compatibility constraints, or other details that may help
us understand the request.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I searched existing issues for a duplicate.
- [ ] This request is not a security report.
